product.olivetti-philos-20.summary: The Philos 20 is named in a collection and the 20/22 family software index.
product.olivetti-philos-20.history: The Museo del Computer holds a Philos 20 notebook. The support archive preserved by DriverGuide groups it with the 22 within the Philos notebook line.
product.olivetti-philos-20.architecture: The support index helps identify family files. DriverGuide lists SYSBIOS.BIN in the Phil20_22_261.zip package.
product.olivetti-philos-20.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-philos-20.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-philos-20.museum: Museo del Computer, Olivetti collection index.
product.olivetti-philos-20.support: DriverGuide, Olivetti PHILOS 20 & 22 Family Driver, file index.
